_readme: Cross-language parity corpus for the MCP protocol-version set (ADR-063 D1). Go reads it from hub/internal/mcpver/mcpver_test.go; TypeScript reads it from desktop/electron/src/browserbridge.test.ts. Neither language owns it — it is the referee both are checked against, because a shared constant is impossible across the language boundary and a copied list drifts. Adding a revision means editing three places: mcpver.go, browserbridge.ts, and this file.
